label: Type 2 diabetes
notes: Sources were fetched live on recorded_at with the project's own connectors: PubMed E-utilities (esearch with guideline / systematic-review filters over the last 6 years plus targeted searches for ACP, KDIGO, AACE, ACSM and national guidelines, then efetch XML) and the MedlinePlus Health Topics web service (dates from the topic page's DC.Date meta tags). Metadata are unedited. condition.json comes from the MeSH descriptor lookup for 'Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2' (D003924) and its entry terms, because the MeSH lookup alone returns no descriptor for the typed text 'type 2 diabetes' (live runs now resolve it through the Entrez entry-term step). All llm/*.json outputs were hand-authored from the real abstracts for replay and demo use; they are not Gemini output. Every evidence, milestone and conflict quote is a verbatim span of its source excerpt. write_report.json is written for the AI-suggested selection and suggested conflict resolutions. Contract 1.1 (2026-10-03): evidence 'stance' and conflict position 'side' values were added by hand from the same abstracts; source tiers were recomputed with the title rule (the ACP 2018 'Guidance Statement', indexed by PubMed as a Review, is now tier 1); the CKD first-line conflict was rewritten to two genuine, full-sentence positions with a neutral assessment. Suggested resolutions are computed at run time, not stored. Public copy: abstracts from publishers outside the open-licence allowlist are cut down to the sentences quoted as evidence (joined with ' … '); see fixtures/README.md.
